decision: Reserve quest-location targeting is pinned to exact target name RezervBase. This closes only the exact location-selection gate for authored post-0.1.0 operations; it does not prove objective uniqueness, same-raid coupling or runtime materialization safety.
regressionBoundary: Any change away from RezervBase, or any future upstream SPT location-authority change affecting Reserve targeting, requires this proof to be re-pinned and reviewed before materialization.
